none: PAS FindID 991087: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Tetricus I (271-274), irregular, Reece period 13, Spes Publica, Cunetio no. 3005. Obverse description: Radiate head right, bearded. Obverse inscription: [--]CVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Stick figure in tunic mincing left with right arm raised, loops or breasts under the arms. Reverse inscription: [SPES PVBLICA]. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 2.05gms, die axis: 6
